records.statement: KafkaProducer.sendMessage registers whenComplete at the publication call site; result/exception callback is the separate webhook-callback implementation. The callback closes over event and correlationId. It logs completion and does not supply a broker consumer handoff or synchronously unwind a returned HTTP response. Typed future/closure continuation binding is not currently native.
assumptions: Source-backed association/validation policy; does not establish effective deployment or imported implementation correspondence

records.statement: ScheduledMessageProducer.sendHeartbeat registers whenComplete after sending a null value; its separate heartbeat-callback receives result/throwable and closes over start/messageKey to compute duration and log success/failure. This is a local future callback, not a Kafka consumer. Typed future/closure transfer remains a model/query limitation.
assumptions: Source-backed association/validation policy; does not establish effective deployment or imported implementation correspondence

records.statement: Source validation policies not expressible as simple scalar shape-field constraints: PSP text is uppercased then passed to imported Psp.valueOf; IP policy combines source-excluded path OR any configured PSP IP matcher; forwarded-address precedence and first-item selection precede matching. InboundRequest declares NonNull payload/params/headers; getHeader/getParam use Optional.orElseThrow for missing values. Stripe SDK constructEvent verifies the raw payload against signature/secret with local signature-exception translation. Imported enum values, Lombok/framework enforcement, proxy trust, signature algorithm/tolerance and HTTP error mapping remain unresolved; no pattern, complete enum or additional-properties rule is invented.
assumptions: Source-backed association/validation policy; does not establish effective deployment or imported implementation correspondence

records.statement: Metadata/source/event validation depends on related values and configuration: payload/additionalParameters/metadata must be present; source candidates are checked in source then system_name order after case-folding against configured allowed sources; an empty allowed-event set permits all event types, otherwise membership is required. SourceEventsConfig initially allows all imported enum members. These are control/configuration invariants, not static scalar field enums or complete runtime schema guarantees; malformed dynamic map types and unresolved enum conversion can still fail.
assumptions: Source-backed association/validation policy; does not establish effective deployment or imported implementation correspondence
